name: Video Editor
description: Programmatic video with Remotion: write React compositions, preview them live in the canvas with the Remotion Player, and render real MP4s from the same entry file.

quickCommands.label: Open Studio
quickCommands.description: Launch the Remotion Studio timeline editor at http://localhost:3000

quickCommands.label: Render Main MP4
quickCommands.description: Render the Main composition to out/main.mp4
quickCommands.command: bun x remotion render src/index.ts Main out/main.mp4

quickCommands.label: Install Render Browser
quickCommands.description: Make sure the headless browser Remotion renders with is installed
